inbox.subject: Quote request - bulk Rock & Metal tracks
inbox.body:
Hi Jane,

We spoke briefly at the trade show last month - I run procurement for a chain of themed cafes and we'd like to license background music for our locations.

Could you put together a quote for the following?

- 40 Rock tracks
- 25 Metal tracks
- 10 of your best-selling tracks overall (your pick)

We're a new account - I don't think we're in your system yet. Company is Northern Lights Cafes, and you can reach me at this address.

If the pricing works we'd want to move quickly. Thanks!

Morgan Vale
Procurement, Northern Lights Cafes

drafts.subject: Re: Quote request - bulk Rock & Metal tracks
drafts.body:
Hi Morgan,

Thanks for reaching out!

Here is the quote for your requested tracks:

- 40 Rock tracks @ $0.99 each = $39.60
- 25 Metal tracks @ $0.99 each = $24.75
- 10 Best-selling tracks @ $0.99 each = $9.90

Subtotal: $74.25
Discount (10% for 75 tracks): -$7.43
Grand Total: $66.82

Please let me know if this works for you or if you have any questions. We're happy to help you get these tracks licensed quickly.

Best regards,

Jane Peacock
Sales Support Agent
Chinook
